summary: Session 3 closed Findings #4 (stale-file clean) + #6 (status-envelope provenance) + the optional cross-DB roll-up index per the user's explicit opt-in. Pipeline.cs: Extract/Translate/Enrich/Run gained a trailing `bool clean = true` parameter that deletes the target tier directory (raw/, kb/, ir/) before re-emission, matching the spec's clean-by-default contract; orphan IR files from objects removed between runs no longer survive. New `public static Pipeline.EmitRootIndex(string outputRoot)` scans `<outputRoot>/AccessMetaData/*/manifest.json` and writes a deterministic name-sorted `<outputRoot>/AccessMetaData/index.json` with shape `{SchemaType:AccessMetaDataRootIndex, SchemaVersion:1.0, Databases:[{Name, Manifest, SchemaVersion}, ...]}`; called from Run after EmitManifestArtifacts so every harvester run refreshes the cross-DB roll-up. Program.cs: new `--no-clean` flag (default = clean), new `RunRun`/`RunExtract`/`RunTranslate` envelope fields HarvesterVersion (deterministic) + StartedAt (UTC ISO-8601, non-deterministic) + DurationMs (non-deterministic) + Clean (effective per-tier clean mode); PrintUsage updated with `--no-clean` documentation and an `IMPORTANT:` paragraph spelling out the `--types` + default-clean interaction. DatabaseManifest.cs: new `public static ResolveHarvesterVersion()` helper centralises version resolution (reads `typeof(DatabaseManifest).Assembly`'s InformationalVersion, strips the SourceLink `+<sha>` suffix); Pipeline.cs (manifest emission), Program.cs (--json-status envelope), and Program.cs PrintVersion (--version output) all now call this single helper — three prior duplicates collapsed to one. 5 new hermetic PipelineCleanTests cover Enrich clean=true orphan removal, Enrich clean=false orphan preservation, EmitRootIndex shape + sort + determinism + bad-manifest-skip. 1 new integration test method in CliRunTests (co-located in the existing class per the parallel-COM lesson) exercises the --json-status envelope's provenance contract and asserts byte-identical output across two back-to-back runs after StartedAt + DurationMs are stripped. No schema change, no golden regeneration: CanonicalGoldenRegressionTests pass byte-identically against committed v1.1 goldens for both HHC and Northwind (the new root index lives at `<stagingRoot>/AccessMetaData/index.json`, OUTSIDE the per-DB BaseDir comparison scope; the GoldenNormalizer's HarvesterVersion placeholder absorbs the new short-form version string). dotnet build = 0 errors / pre-existing CA1416 + NU1903 warnings only. R1 cross-provider verification by gpt-5-4 returned ISSUES_FOUND (1 Major HarvesterVersion provenance mismatch + 1 Minor --types-interaction docs gap); both fixed in-session; R2 verification by gpt-5-4 returned VERIFIED with empty issues array. Total Session 3 routed cost $0.4016 (R1 gpt-5-4 session-verification $0.26272 + R2 gpt-5-4 session-verification $0.13595 + gemini-pro Session 4 next-orchestrator analysis $0.00292). Pre-existing parallel-COM flake in ClassifyCommandTests (full Integration suite end-to-end) is NOT in Session 3's call path and is documented in the issue log; mitigation deferred to a future cleanup session.
